name: Interval Tree with Cell Grouping
definition: An interval tree variant where each pointer in the auxiliary lists represents a group of eight adjacent cells instead of a single cell, reducing memory overhead.
summary: Interval Tree with Cell Grouping is a memory-optimized variant of the Standard Interval Tree for Isosurface Extraction that reduces tree size to approximately one-eighth by grouping eight adjacent cells per pointer, at the cost of increased query time.
